WITNESS_CAPTURE_READS: Reproduction captures up to 25 read rows per statement for data witnesses. You can turn read capture off.
WITNESS_CONFIG_REQUIRED: Set CRUMBTRAIL_ENDPOINT and CRUMBTRAIL_AGENT_TOKEN, then name the project and issue.
WITNESS_CONNECTION_FAILED: Could not read the witness on {target}. Run this command where the database is reachable.
WITNESS_CONNECTION_REQUIRED: Set {name} to the database connection string or SQLite file path.
WITNESS_FIX_FAILED: The repair script failed. No after observation was uploaded.
WITNESS_FIX_REQUIRED: Name a readable repair script with --fix-script. Its contents identify the fix.
WITNESS_INVALID: The witness is incomplete or contains unsupported query instructions. Request a new witness.
WITNESS_NON_REPRODUCIBLE: The data is not in the incident's state and may already be repaired. Investigate the environment and configuration.
WITNESS_READS_ON: Database read capture is on, capped at 25 rows per statement.
WITNESS_REFUSED: No executable witness is available. Inspect the issue's captured database evidence.
WITNESS_REPRODUCTION_ASK: Enable data reproduction? Capture up to 25 read rows per statement for data witnesses. You can turn read capture off later.
WITNESS_REPRODUCTION_FORBIDDEN: An organization administrator can change data reproduction settings.
WITNESS_REPRODUCTION_READ_FAILED: Could not read data reproduction settings.
WITNESS_REPRODUCTION_SAVE_FAILED: Could not save data reproduction settings. Try again.
WITNESS_REPRODUCTION_UNCHANGED: Data reproduction settings were left unchanged. Review them in capture settings.
WITNESS_REQUEST_FAILED: Crumbtrail could not complete the request. Check the endpoint and project credentials.
WITNESS_SESSION_PENDING: The observations are uploaded but still processing. Settle this run after both sessions finish.
WITNESS_WAIT: Apply the named repair script, then press Enter to record the after state.
